a) The minimum number of years of general experience in the construction works as Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or
Management Contractor shall be 10 (ten) years.
(b)) The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in construction works of
at least one (01) contract of similar nature, complexity and methods/construction technology successfully completed within the last
five (05) years, with a value of at least Tk. 60 (Sixty) crore
Specific experience means similar nature of works
The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk.70.00 (Seventy) Crore over last 5 (five) years and in its
support necessary payment certificate must be submitted along (as per below Table) with the Tender. Year counting backward from
the date of publication of IFT in the Webpage. [No audit report will be considered for calculating turnover]
The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk.12.00 (Twelve) Crore and in
its support necessary bank certificate (must mentioned this tender ID and / or the name of work)
Price Adjustment will be applicable for the following cost components: Cement, Re-bar, Coarse Aggregate, Fine Aggregates,
Bitumen, First Class/P.J. Bricks, Ordinary Labour only
The weightings or coefficients for adjustment will be specified during signing Contract Agreement
Brief Description of Works : Improvement and Widening of Holiday Mor to Khurushkul Mor at Cox's Bazar between Ch. 0+000 – 2+450 Km
(Dismantling and relocation works, erecting site facilities, earthworks, flexible and rigid pavements construction, foundation works,
erection fencing / boundary walls, storm-water and utility/service drain construction, construction of culverts and saucer drain,
construction of median and public sheds, construction sewerage line and providing road marking and signage etc. detailed in
drawings, bill of quantities etc.)
